pages.text: Fermentation requires a barrel $(item)Warmth of at least 3$() and an internal $(item)Barrel Humidity of at least 25$(). The tobacco must not already be fermented or ruined.

Once the barrel enters Fermenting mode, it needs $(item)48,000 ticks$(), about $(item)2 Minecraft days$(), under continuously valid fermentation conditions. If conditions force a mode change, the fermentation progress resets.
pages.title: Time

pages.text: Successful fermentation marks the tobacco $(thing)Fermented$() and adds $(item)+7 quality$(), with quality allowed to rise as high as 120. Fermentation happens only once per tobacco batch.
pages.title: Result

pages.text: Barrel Humidity is an internal reservoir that builds over time. Warm, humid surroundings fill it more quickly. The Spectacles show the environmental warmth/humidity; sneak-right-clicking the barrel also reports Barrel Humidity itself.
pages.title: Humidity Charge
